verdict.rationale: No evidence in the pack of any export feature for hosts, keychain, snippets, or logs into open/portable formats; the product is described as closed-source with cloud-synced vaults, and community comments even raise concerns about lock-in to Termius's own storage rather than exportability. missing for 10: any documented export command/format, data portability docs, or independent confirmation of exiting the platform with data intact.
